v30-6.candidate: David was greatly afflicted, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was in anguish, each over his sons and daughters. But David was strengthened in the Lord his God.

v30-24.candidate: Who would listen to these words of yours? For they are no less than you. For as is the share of the one who goes down into war, so shall be the share of the one who stays with the equipment. They shall share equally.”
